description_en: Queries the range of public IP addresses in a virtual private cloud (VPC) in a specified region
description_zh: 调用DescribePublicIpAddress接口查询指定地域中位于专有网络的公网IP地址的范围
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-public-ip-address --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ip-version ipv4 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePublicIpAddress

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page in a paged query.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页的行数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The region to query.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询的地域。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The version of the IP protocol. Valid values:

ipv4 (default): IPv4.

ipv6: IPv6
parameters.help_zh:
IP 协议的版本。取值：

ipv4（默认值）：IPv4 协议。

ipv6：IPv6 协议
parameters.name: ip_version

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数

PublicIpAddress.description_en: The range of public IP addresses in a virtual private cloud (VPC) in the specified region
PublicIpAddress.description_zh: 指定地域中位于专有网络的公网IP地址的范围

items.description_en: The range of public IP addresses in a virtual private cloud (VPC) in the specified region
items.description_zh: 指定地域中位于专有网络的公网IP地址的范围

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the public IP address

true：成功。
